### Surf — G4 *Friendship is Magic*

**Who she is.** A light-pink earth-pony mare with a bright-blue high ponytail, yellow lightning-bolt ear jewelry, orange sunglasses, a hot-pink jacket, and a surfboard cutie mark. Alongside her blue-and-blond companion **Turf**, she cuts ahead of Fluttershy at the asparagus stand in *Putting Your Hoof Down* (S2E19, 2012). Surf tells Fluttershy, “Get a life.” [Episode transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Putting_Your_Hoof_Down)

**Naming and continuity.** “Surf” and “Turf” are fan/character-index **placeholder names**, not names spoken in the episode. “Surf” suits her surfboard cutie mark; the original coiner and date are unverified. They are not characters from the later *Surf and/or Turf* (S8E6, 2018), which concerns Terramar’s hippogriff/seapony family. [Character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) · [Later episode](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Surf_and_or_Turf)

**Speaking and appearances.** She has a short, Valley-girl-style speaking role. IMDbPro attributes **Tabitha St. Germain** to Surf (and **Andrea Libman** to Turf), but these database labels do not establish on-screen character-name credits. The character index also records appearances in *The Saddle Row Review* (S6E9) and the short *Pinkercise w/ Pinkie Pie!*. No separate alter ego is verified. [Cast listing](https://pro.imdb.com/title/tt2230279/)

**Show still.** Original TV animation: *Friendship is Magic* production (Hasbro/DHX); hosted on Derpibooru, with the uploader unverified.
